subject: Prodify — Architecture review & implementation prep
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.in>

Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@prodify.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prodify — Architecture review & implementation prep

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for the discovery last week. We captured the topology and key constraints in the attached discovery notes (short PDF) — see the ‘Data flow & compliance’ section for the items we called out.

Next step from our side is a focused architecture/implementation deep-dive to validate the integration points and sizing assumptions. Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- Short recap (5m)
- Prodify infra & traffic patterns (you) (10m)
- Redwood serving topology options and tradeoffs (15m)
- Questions, next steps, mutual action items (10m)

I can do the following slots (PST):
- Thu Apr 19 10:00–10:45
- Thu Apr 19 14:00–14:45
- Fri Apr 20 08:30–09:15

If those don’t work, send a few times that suit Evan and your infra lead and I’ll loop in our infra architect (Jonas) and pre-sales lead (Ben). I’ve attached a precall checklist you might find useful.

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.in
(Attachment: Prodify-Discovery-Notes.pdf)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the summary and the notes — helpful. Evan and I are keen to get into the implementation details. Quick hiccup: our infra lead was pulled into an outage on Thu afternoon so the 14:00 slot won’t work. Evan proposed Tue Apr 23 morning or Fri Apr 20 afternoon (ET). Our calendar looks free:
- Tue Apr 23 10:30–11:15 ET
- Fri Apr 20 15:00–15:45 ET

We prefer the earlier slot on Tue if that’s possible. Also, I added our security SME, Mira Patel (mira.patel@prodify.com), to the thread — she’ll just observe unless we get into SOC2 specifics.

—Aisha

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.in>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha@prodify.com>
Cc: Evan Li <evan.li@prodify.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.in>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.in>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prodify — Architecture review & implementation prep

Hi Aisha / Evan / Mira —

Tue Apr 23 10:30–11:15 ET works for us. I’ve penciled it in and will send a calendar invite once Ben confirms.

A few prep notes so the session is productive:
- If possible, please share a network diagram and a sample peak RPS/avg latency for your API gateway (we’ll tailor the sizing recommendations). Link or upload to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A12ProdifyShared
- Decide whether you want us to include an on-prem variant (air-gapped) or focus on VPC/cloud-hosted first — we can cover both briefly but it helps to know priorities.
- We’ll review quantization/latency tradeoffs if you’re planning to run larger models; Jonas will cover kernel/kv-cache behavior.

Agenda (final):
1) 5m — goals & success criteria (Aisha)
2) 15m — Prodify traffic & infra constraints (Aisha / Evan)
3) 15m — Redwood serving topologies + fallback policies (Jonas)
4) 10m — operational handoffs, rollout plan, next steps (Ben / Naomi)

(Attachment: Prodify-Precall-Checklist.xlsx)

Thanks — looking forward.
Naomi
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.in>

Confirmed for Tue Apr 23 10:30–11:15 ET — calendar invite sent.

Quick note (Jonas to follow up): please add two items to the run-of-show if possible:
- Expected SLA targets (p95 latency at peak)
- Data retention / audit-log retention requirements for model input (any PII flags)

On the call I’ll run through the mutual action plan and next steps for a proof-of-concept. Jonas — can you add a 2-slide appendix on KV cache behavior for long-context prompts?

Thanks,
